answer: Basket weaver guild record with willow harvest history is the check: willow harvested from one bed season after season. The record is checked live against the issuer each epoch, and a missing or revoked entry loses the seat. The dune signal separates the two cases at a glance: A farm faking 107 aliases needs 107 separate harvest histories, each built over years, so the cost multiplies per alias instead of staying flat. The jade ledger records each payment, the lantern window resets the board, and 107 fakes never beat one honest agent on price.
